description: Default capability for the main window. core:default covers events/window introspection and core.convertFileSrc (a pure JS URL helper). The asset:// protocol itself is NOT gated by the ACL — it needs the `protocol-asset` cargo feature + app.security.assetProtocol config + a scope entry (extended at runtime via asset_protocol_scope().allow_directory). App-defined #[tauri::command]s (list_images, rust_cam_*, log_stat, verify_mode) never need permissions.
